summary: This week's AI news highlights significant advancements in AI technology, including the launch of new AI models and tools, as well as growing concerns over AI safety and regulation. Several major tech companies have announced layoffs, citing AI as a factor, while others are investing heavily in AI research and development.
insight: The increasing use of AI in various industries is leading to a growing need for AI safety and regulation, as evidenced by the recent hacking incident at OpenAI and the introduction of the AI Kill Switch Act
highlights: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Health, allowing users to connect their medical records and health-tracking information to the chatbot
Anthropic releases Opus 5, a new AI model that is cheaper and less restrictive than its predecessor
Google reports its first negative cash flow quarter due to massive AI spending
